title: Spot Vol Beta
append: Add one object to series.json points at the session close. Keep dates ascending, one point per session. The intraday gauge lives in latest.json until that close is appended. npm run svb:close writes both files.

routine.cadence: Weekdays, about 3:55 PM CT, after the cash close and the VIX close.
writes: series.json: one close appended, origin close-routine, with the desk estimate close and recordedAt
latest.json: the same close, closed true
rules: Never rewrite or delete an earlier point.
svb is the gauge at the close, not an intraday print.
Leave estimate out when uvDelta was not recorded.
vixCloseMove is close to close; 2 points or more is a formal vol event.
